newsitem.title: USA: Matrix starts Phase II IntraDose trials.
newsitem.headline: Matrix starts Phase II IntraDose trials.

text.p: Matrix Pharmaceutical Inc said Thursday it bagan Phase II trials of its IntraDose treatment in patients with inoperable primary liver cancer. A separate Phase II trial in metastatic liver cancer patients, and a Phase III trial for head and neck cancer are already underway.

IntraDose is an injectable gel using Matrix's Therapeutic Implant technology to deliver chemotherapy drugs directly into solid tumors and skin lesions. The gel contains a biodegradable protein matrix that holds high concentrations of drug within the tumor and retards the rate of release. Martix believes this may increase the effectiveness and cut down on the systemic toxicity associated with intravenous delivery of chemotherapy drugs.
